title: Akassa
description: Akassa is a Benin classic prepared with cornmeal, sourdough starter, peanut sauce. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Akassa-style fermented corn porridge from pantry cornmeal and a yogurt-assisted dough; true fermented maize dough differs.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cool the prepared ingredients promptly, then refrigerate for about 480 minutes until properly chilled.
Steam small covered parcels or heatproof ramekins of the fermented cornmeal mixture until completely set; serve warm.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
